rec.name: PDP Social Proof Banner (Avatar Stack + Rating Pill)

what.text: A configurable social proof banner for the product page, placed in the buy box (e.g. below the buy buttons). It has two modes. (1) 'Social banner': a stack of up to 5 round avatar images, a bold influencer/customer name with an optional blue Instagram-style verified checkmark, and a rich-text line such as 'and 63,000 others are thrilled with us'. (2) 'Rating banner': a full-width pill with rich text in which the placeholder '(rating)' is replaced by five yellow/currentColor stars, e.g. '18,386+ customers rated us 5 stars'. Background colour, text colour, corner style (rounded or square) and top/bottom margin are editable.

why.text: Showing real faces, a recognisable name and a large aggregate number triggers herd behaviour and the bandwagon effect ('others like me already bought'). The verified checkmark borrows social-media credibility and authority. A star rating with a review count is a fast, universally understood trust shortcut. Placing it right by the add-to-cart/buy buttons addresses last-second doubt at the decision point.

how.text: Build it as a product-page block in the theme's main product section (limit 1). Block schema: a 'Type' select (social / rating), colour pickers for background and text, a margin range slider (0–60px), a corner style select (rounded 10px / square 0), five image_picker fields, a text field for the name, a checkbox for the checkmark, a richtext field for the message, a checkbox for bold text, and a richtext field for the rating text (using the '(rating)' token). Render it through a snippet (social-proof-banner.liquid) called from the block loop of the product form. The snippet outputs overlapping 24px circular avatars (-4px overlap, white ring) with the name, the inline SVG checkmark (#4C8AE7) and the text on one flex row. In rating mode the '(rating)' token is replaced with five inline SVG stars via JS. Note: the Liquid in the ticket is theme-specific (it assumes product-form.liquid and main-product.liquid), so instructions must be adapted per theme.

items: Rating banner rich text with '(rating)' placeholder for stars
Requested in the original spec but not in the delivered code: left/centre text alignment, round vs. square avatar images

dependencies.text: No metafields needed (all content is set in the theme editor). Requires a theme with a product-page block loop (e.g. product-form.liquid and a main-product section schema); file names differ per theme. The rating mode needs a small JS snippet to inject the stars. Known bug: 'Enable text in bold' was reported as not visibly working and later fixed. The 'rounded' option in rating mode renders as a 50px pill. The CSS has a typo ('dislay').

items: Click/scroll engagement below the buy box

images.caption: Design reference (hnds.de): two round avatars, influencer names with a blue verified checkmark and 'and 30,000 others wear our jewellery' text.
Design reference (rosental.de): black pill with a bold '18,386+ customers rated us with 5 stars' line and five yellow stars.

Final build in the theme editor: the banner sits below the buy buttons on the PDP with five avatars, name with checkmark and text; the settings panel shows Type, Background, Text, margin, Style and Images 1–5.
Rich-text editor field for the banner text (bold, italic, link, lists).
